name: 甜美名媛 / Coquette Ladylike
scope: 精细浪漫环境、柔窗光与精致社交气氛。
distinctive_features: 精细浪漫环境、柔窗光与精致社交气氛。
与Lolita整套裙型/配套结构展示区分；原有繁复蕾丝完整保留。
base_policy: 未选新组件时保留旧配方；明确用途/媒介/逐张计划替换冲突段，不能把本卡与旧pack重复累加。
input_requirements: 明确当前商品参考及不可改事实；仅展示有依据的视角。
人物来源与允许调整项沿用当前人物记录；不得把服装图中的人脸自动当作身份授权。
boundaries: 风格名是已定义摄影配方，不代表该国家全部审美或人物国籍。
适用品类/anti_categories是默认推荐线索；用户明确保留商品借用摄影时，按实际结构与适龄边界适配，不改成推荐服种。
当前修订未获得新实图验收，旧样片的接受只保留原范围。
garment_preservation: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。
planning_requirements: 场景列表给空间候选，不能由其顺序改变逐张动作。
单张/系列/独立比较/融合按本次意图，多个名称不自动混在一张图。

photography.scene: 法式沙龙浅色墙面，环境细节精细但不遮挡商品。
photography.lighting: 柔和侧前自然光，保留已有细节与表面质感。
photography.composition: 细节密度有主次，精致环境形成轻柔围合，避免道具堆满画面。 每张按已确认的逐张计划组织。
photography.palette: 奶油白、浅粉、香槟色或淡灰用于环境，商品颜色不被淡化。 商品原色与饱和度保持不变。

prompt_fragment: 本卡审美意图：精致甜美编辑摄影：细腻浪漫、优雅而有分寸；甜美通过画面气氛表达，不补造蝴蝶结或蕾丝。 摄影内容只使用本次解析后的 photography 字段；人物气质仅按当前人物条件处理，不另行拼接旧 pack 全文。

art.direction: 精致甜美编辑摄影：细腻浪漫、优雅而有分寸；甜美通过画面气氛表达，不补造蝴蝶结或蕾丝。
limits: 服装和允许搭配分别记录；原商品的版型、衣长、领袖、开合、层次、颜色、材质、图案、标识及配饰以参考为准。
配色与艺术语言不得给原商品染色、增删装饰、收腰、加长或改变露肤范围。
身份、年龄、体型与头眼动作由当前人物条件和逐张计划决定，风格名不决定人物国籍、族群或脸型。
照片只能证明可见特征；手工、手织、手绣、材质成分等来源声明须另有依据。

negatives: 不新增商品参考中没有的服装部件、图案、首饰或品牌标识
不通过拉长身体、缩腰或改变人物年龄制造风格
不加入广告标题、价格、促销语、品牌口号或海报版式；商品原有文字标识保留
no added lace scenery obscuring the garment; preserve all lace in the reference
acceptance: 商品与人物事实分别对照原始参考，不能只拿上一次生成图互相核对。
独立成图满足本次画幅与逐张计划；联系表或预览不能替代独立图片。
风格差异来自所选视觉手段，不能以改变商品或身份换取差异。
与Lolita整套裙型/配套结构展示区分；原有繁复蕾丝完整保留。
光线、色彩与场景的具体特征可在画面中判断；不以名字或形容词代替验收。

evidence.scope: 当前修订尚无实图验收；既有历史记录保留，不自动扩展其接受范围。

persona: gentle polished confidence, graceful composure, refined charm
persona_guidance: 仅当本次人物条件允许调整时采用；已锁定的身份、年龄、妆发与表情优先。gentle polished confidence, graceful composure, refined charm

commitments.show: soft front-side window light with a gentle glow; low contrast and creamy highlights; every lace or fine detail stays readable
commitments.check: shadows very soft and low in contrast; highlights not blown; fine garment detail readable

commitments.show: a light refined salon: cream or blush panelled walls and one delicate piece per cell (upholstered chair, tea table, vintage mirror or a few flowers), never crowding the garment
commitments.check: panel moulding or delicate furniture visible; at most one prop per cell; nothing overlaps the garment

commitments.show: gentle, sweet, socially composed expression: a soft closed-lip smile with bright, warm eyes
commitments.check: a soft closed-lip smile in most cells; eyes bright and warm; no open-mouthed laugh and no cold look

commitments.show: polished soft-pink makeup: rosy blush high on the cheeks, a satin pink lip, defined lashes; hair neatly smoothed or softly waved
realize: hair length stays as the identity reference
no bows or hair accessories that are not in the references
commitments.check: blush visible on the cheeks; lip pink with a satin sheen; hair smooth or softly waved; no added hair accessory

commitments.show: graceful, delicate body language: soft curves, small head tilts, light fingertip gestures, knees or ankles kept together
commitments.check: in most cells knees or ankles are together and at least one hand makes a light fingertip gesture; no wide stance

action_tendency: Graceful and socially poised: soft curves, small head tilts, light fingertip gestures, ankles together or crossed; feminine but never childish or sexualized.

pose_vocabulary.body: standing with ankles crossed and knees softly together, weight shifted slightly onto one leg, head tilted a little
pose_vocabulary.hands: hands lightly clasped behind the back
pose_vocabulary.check: ankles crossed, knees together, head tilt; garment front fully clear

pose_vocabulary.body: sitting sideways on an upholstered salon chair, knees together angled to one side, ankles crossed, back tall with the head tilted toward one shoulder
pose_vocabulary.hands: hands folded softly on the lap
pose_vocabulary.check: knees together and angled, ankles crossed, hands on the lap, head tilt

pose_vocabulary.body: half-body seated at a small tea table, shoulders soft, chin slightly lifted
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand lifts a teacup by the handle off to one side, the other rests by the saucer
pose_vocabulary.avoid_when: garments whose key front detail sits where the cup would cross
pose_vocabulary.check: teacup held to the side; garment front not covered; chin lifted

pose_vocabulary.body: standing beside a vintage mirror, body angled toward it, face turned back toward camera
pose_vocabulary.hands: fingertips of one hand resting lightly on the mirror frame, the other relaxed
pose_vocabulary.check: fingertips on the mirror frame; body toward the mirror, face toward camera

pose_vocabulary.body: a light half-turn on the balls of the feet, one heel lifted, the hem caught in slight motion
pose_vocabulary.hands: hands lightly open at the sides
pose_vocabulary.avoid_when: structured garments that should not swing
pose_vocabulary.check: one heel lifted; small motion in the hem; light open hands

pose_vocabulary.body: sitting on a white garden bench, legs together extended on a diagonal, leaning slightly to one side
pose_vocabulary.hands: one hand on the bench behind the hip, the other resting on the knee
pose_vocabulary.check: diagonal leg line, lean onto one hand, legs together

pose_vocabulary.body: back three-quarter to camera, chin dipped toward the shoulder, eyes lowered demurely, head tilted
pose_vocabulary.hands: arms relaxed with fingertips lightly together in front
pose_vocabulary.check: back readable; demure chin-to-shoulder tilt; no laugh

pose_vocabulary.body: half-body, head tilted, eyes lifted to camera
pose_vocabulary.hands: fingertips of one hand touching the edge of the jaw, the other out of frame
pose_vocabulary.check: fingertips at the jaw; head tilt; neckline still visible
